advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Exercise the run-span enclosure over the real code-review candidate fan-out (drive a candidate read through _run_code_review_gate/candidate_span) rather than only through a monkeypatched _code_review_preflight short-circuit.
evidence: tests/unit/test_run_span.py:253 `monkeypatch.setattr(gate_dispatch, "_code_review_preflight", _fake_preflight)` couples the assertion to a module-internal helper name

gate_dispatch.py:384-389 `with run_span("review-code", ...): early = _code_review_preflight(request); if early is not None: return early; prep = _assemble_code_review_run(request); return _run_code_review_gate(request, prep)` -- the real candidate fan-out is in _run_code_review_gate, which the short-circuit skips

The real per-candidate spans open via CodeReviewBatchRunner -> tracing.candidate_span (tracing.py:96); the test drives none of that path, so it cannot detect a run_span placement regression that only affects the deep gate run
ABSENCE: no assertion exercises the run span enclosing _run_code_review_gate; the reads are placed in the preflight surrogate returned before assemble/run
advisory.finding: The code-review run-span test injects its two candidate reads inside a monkeypatched internal _code_review_preflight (an EARLY short-circuit), so it never exercises the real multi-pass candidate fan-out in _run_code_review_gate/CodeReviewBatchRunner; a regression that opened run_span too narrowly (enclosing only the deeper gate steps, or moving it inside the gate) would leave the real candidate spans orphaned yet keep this test green, and the monkeypatch also couples the test to the internal helper name so a behaviour-preserving inline/rename breaks it.

coaching.subject: coverage gap in real multi-pass candidate fan-out path
